entities.summary: Prathiba Maninder Singh is a judge of the Delhi High Court, in India. She has made significant contributions to academic literature and legal developments in Indian intellectual property law, as a practicing lawyer, and as an advisor to several legislative committees concerned with drafting related legislation.
